title: Expected influence under extended restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, and choose a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The average, over random coordinate restrictions weighted by $\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}$ and uniform signs outside $J$, of the influence of coordinate $i$ in the extended restricted function equals $\delta$ times the influence of coordinate $i$ in $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
